case.name: Drawer Control Batch & POS Purchase Payment Propagation Batch
case.description: Runs the point-of-sale Cashier Drawer Control and Purchase Payment Propagation batches to reconcile drawer and payment data.

steps.name: Run the POS Purchase Payment Propagation batch
steps.description: Enqueues Auctifera.POSPurchasePaymentPropagationBatch via Database.executeBatch, captures the returned AsyncApexJob Id, and query-back-verifies the job was ACCEPTED (Status in Holding/Queued/Preparing/Processing/Completed). Throws (step FAILED) only if the enqueue itself throws (e.g. class not global/visible from anonymous Apex) or no AsyncApexJob row exists for the returned Id. SCOPE is a PM-editable constant. This batch exists ONLY in the Auctifera namespace (no vnfp equivalent) and its no-arg constructor IS global (confirmed by a live run on org im696-tucson — the job reached Completed). Verifies ENQUEUE success, not batch COMPLETION (the batch runs async).

steps.name: Run the Cashier Drawer Control batch (manual)
steps.description: MANUAL: the Cashier Drawer Control batch cannot be triggered from anonymous Apex — its no-arg constructor is non-global in BOTH the Auctifera and vnfp namespaces (live probe on org im696-tucson returned 'Method is not visible: void Auctifera.CashierDrawerControlBatch.<init>()' and the same for vnfp), and the org ships no global schedulable wrapper for it. Run it by hand: 1) App Launcher > search 'Veevart Settings' and open it. 2) Under 'Point of Sale (POS)' open 'Batches'. 3) On the 'Cashier Drawer Control' (a.k.a. Drawer Control) batch click 'Run' (or 'Run & Schedule' to set a recurring schedule). 4) Confirm the batch was accepted (a job appears in Setup > Apex Jobs). Mark this step done after the job is queued.

template.name: IC 3.22: Drawer Control Batch & POS Purchase Payment Propagation Batch
template.description: Single-case template for 3.22 (HYBRID: one AUTOMATED T6 enqueue step for the POS Purchase Payment Propagation batch + one MANUAL handoff for the Cashier Drawer Control batch, whose constructor is non-global). Proves the batch-scheduling (enqueue + AsyncApexJob query-back) pattern for the invocable batch. Dependency wiring lives in the multi-case W4 master template, not here.
